name: DETAIL - SDXL
author: Pfannkuchensack
description: Callable detailer sub workflow (SDXL). Finds a named part of the image and re-renders it at higher effective resolution.
tags: callable, sub workflow, detail, hyperdetailer, SDXL
notes:
Pfannkuchensacks Workflow Package

Callable "detail one part of the image" sub workflow (SDXL).

Grounding DINO finds the thing named in "Detect", Segment Anything turns that
into a mask, the masked region is cropped out, scaled up to a workable
resolution, re-denoised with the mask, scaled back and pasted into the original.

"Detect" is just a text prompt - Face, hands, eyes, hair, ... - so one workflow
covers every body part. Chain several calls to detail more than one thing.

Returns image + latents + metadata, like every other sub workflow in this pack,
and the image input uses the same node id, so a Call Saved Workflow node can be
switched between REFINE and DETAIL without losing its wiring.

Working resolution: the original used the "ideal_size" node, which hard-requires
a UNetField and raises for anything that is not SD1/SD2/SDXL. It is replaced by
plain math that reproduces the same result for the 1024-class models in this
pack:

    w = D * sqrt(cropW / cropH)      h = D / sqrt(cropW / cropH)      w * h = D^2

Both branches of ideal_size are algebraically identical; the branch only decides
which side gets clamped to D/2, which is done here with two MAX nodes. Sides are
floored to a multiple of 16 (not 8 as ideal_size does): krea2_denoise and the
2x2 patch packing of the Qwen-Image VAE require 16, and every multiple of 16 is
also a valid multiple of 8 for the SD-style bases.

This workflow needs no custom node packs. The SDXL original round-tripped the
model through XYGrid's sdxl_model_to_string / string_to_sdxl_model purely to get
a connectable ModelIdentifierField; core's "Any Model" (model_identifier) does
the same in one node where the loader accepts a connection.

data.content: SDXL: CFG ~5-8, Steps ~30. Scheduler sits on the Denoise node. "Detect" is a Grounding DINO text prompt - Face, hands, eyes, hair. Denoising Start around 0.35-0.5 adds detail without changing identity.
